title: GT Arena Motocross
seo_title: GT Arena Motocross at Cowan Civic Center, Lebanon MO
description: GT Arena Motocross is the General Tire Arenacross, an indoor racing event with head-to-head races and both professional and amateur riders. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026, from 7:00 PM to 11:45 PM at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, MO, and is also listed for December 12.
